web.title: vast-data/mattsvlm: Processing Video POC with Multimodal LLMs - GitHub
web.description:
# Matt's VLM Pipeline
## Overview
It performs temporal decomposition of video content through frame extraction, processes these frames using a multimodal Large Language Model (LLM), and generates semantically meaningful analysis based on user-defined prompts.

## Features ⚡️
- 🎥 Extract frames from video files at a specified rate

## Usage 💻
```
uv run python app.py sample/chunk_0002.mp4 "describe what is happening in this video"
```

```
uv run python app.py video.mp4 "identify objects in the scene" -fps 12
```

## Examples ✅
```
uv run python app.py myvideo.mp4
```

```
uv run python app.py myvideo.mp4 "outline the clothing worn by the characters" -fps 10
```
